authority: This file is the structural interface specification. Method tables, ALG-CLTAV-01 calls and FIG-CL-TAV-09 ports must match it. It is not a solver choice and not a source-faithfulness proof.

SessionContext.init: S0: retryCount=0; qStatus=UNKNOWN and currentSummary absent unless declared; exclusive resource mode recorded; q/currentSummary and retry/Rmax are aliases of Γ fields
SessionContext.writers: qStatus records knownness, while currentSummary is the observable successor summary read by prediction and selection. S7 assigns UNKNOWN and clears currentSummary only for UNKNOWN-EFFECT, prepErr, an unconfirmed Prep successor summary, or unconfirmed Recover target. CONFIRMED-NOT-SENT changes neither. S8 is the sole writer of KNOWN on confirmed Recover. S9 is the sole writer of currentSummary after a confirmed successor summary from IF-OBS-INTERPRET or IF-PREP-RECOVER. IF-PREP-RECOVER does not write Γ

HistoryHandle.init: S0: empty compatible-state handles; H=H0; statusByHypothesis unset
HistoryHandle.sameHDifferentHistory: Two handles may share the same H set while compatibleStateByHypothesis differs; HistoryHandle is not discarded when only H is printed
HistoryHandle.unknownEffect: UNKNOWN-EFFECT and unconfirmed Recover: do not exclude H; mark statusByHypothesis CONSERVATIVE-UNKNOWN. CONFIRMED-NOT-SENT leaves compatible history unchanged

SelectSnapshot.writtenBy: S3-SNAP after IF-SELECT-ADMIT has determined the final non-ADMIT action and before charge, execute, interpret, or IF-PREP-RECOVER

interfaces.pre: session declared; Hsubseteq H0; HistoryHandle belongs to this session
interfaces.guarantee: classes project onto current H; empty current prediction is not scored as remaining |H|; q is read from Γ.currentSummary only while qStatus is KNOWN
interfaces.failure: PredictionGapError is TEST-scoped: it withholds TEST scoring and does not by itself block eligible Recover or Prep
interfaces.stateEffect: read-only on HistoryHandle; does not charge

interfaces.pre: one resource mode declared; prediction for this iteration already produced
interfaces.guarantee: kind is exclusive TEST, PREP, RECOVER or ADMIT; tStar is the final action, including the one-step TEST minimax and tie rule; nonempty A is not executable S; never argmin empty TEST set; Prep/Recover are not scored as observation minimax; empty C does not force A3 when Recover or Prep is eligible
interfaces.failure: no currently valid class: named prediction-gap for TEST only, not A3 when Recover/Prep remains eligible
interfaces.stateEffect: does not charge; does not update HistoryHandle

interfaces.pre: action admitted this iteration; charged once
interfaces.guarantee: unadmitted action is not issued; an effect class is not a second charge
interfaces.failure: CONFIRMED-NOT-SENT leaves q unchanged; UNKNOWN-EFFECT does not mean state-unchanged
interfaces.stateEffect: one charge already applied by S4; writes record into session log

interfaces.guarantee: T5 interval treatment; pairing per method 3.6; every normal confirmed observation returns a confirmed successor postSummary, possibly unchanged
interfaces.failure: If a successor summary cannot be confirmed, return UNKNOWN-EFFECT rather than retaining a stale known summary. CONFIRMED-NOT-SENT, UNKNOWN-EFFECT, prepErr and unconfirmed Recover share the S7 retry counter; UNKNOWN-EFFECT is not state-unchanged; CONFIRMED-NOT-SENT is not UNKNOWN

interfaces.pre: selected kind is PREP or RECOVER; retry cap and A4/A5 order
interfaces.guarantee: targetConfirmed records whether the requested Prep/Recover target was reached; summaryConfirmed records whether the actual successor observable summary is confirmed. targetConfirmed=false may coexist with summaryConfirmed=true for Prep when the actual successor is known. A confirmed Recover requires both true and returns declaredTarget, evidence, and a confirmed successor postSummary; this interface does not write Γ
interfaces.failure: Prep with summaryConfirmed=false, and Recover with targetConfirmed=false, join S7 as UNKNOWN-EFFECT-equivalent outcome; prepErr marks conservative-unknown. CONFIRMED-NOT-SENT does not fabricate KNOWN and does not assign UNKNOWN
interfaces.stateEffect: returns values only and does not write Γ or η; S8 is the sole writer of qStatus=KNOWN on confirmed Recover; S9 is the sole writer of currentSummary after a confirmed postSummary; postSummary is not qUsedAtSelect

interfaces.pre: valid observation class or summaryConfirmed=true successor postSummary; not an effect-class retry
interfaces.guarantee: advance from the select-time snapshot; whole-history path; no resurrection; HistoryHandlePrime is the next IF-PRED-OBS input; qUsedAtSelect is SelectSnapshot, not the post-effect currentSummary; postSummary is a different field. A confirmed Prep with no valid Iz advances operation history and preserves H
interfaces.failure: invalid/unknown effect: do not exclude H; mark statusByHypothesis CONSERVATIVE-UNKNOWN
interfaces.stateEffect: updates HistoryHandle version; two same-H different-history handles remain distinct

interfaces.pre: Stop-Equivalent exclusive with P1-P3 and P5
interfaces.guarantee: no proof implies not proved equivalent
interfaces.successorClose: optional proof algorithm; not required this round

interfaces.pre: exclusive stop order Empty, Singleton, 645, Equivalent, Budget; retry cap is a distinct Stop-Error
interfaces.guarantee: singleton h_normal is not protocol PASS; named residuals are not dropped
interfaces.failure: do not convert retry-cap Stop-Error into Stop-Budget
interfaces.stateEffect: ERROR/retry already charged once in S4

experimentInterfaces.failure: missing identity is not a runnable scene
planned is not confirmed; unconfirmed is not valid truth
unconfirmed injection cannot default to valid truth; separate store is not independence
experimentInterfaces.sharedWithMethod: named parsers/clocks/models must list common-error risk

experimentInterfaces.failure: missing correlation id is invalid observation
arm abort is ERROR, not PASS
experimentInterfaces.resourceBasis: one declared mode; no gifted CL-LOOP records

experimentInterfaces.failure: unconfirmed, invalid, equivalent, or abstain are not detection PASS/FAIL
experimentInterfaces.visibility: evaluator-only labels; algorithm does not see the class name as a select input

experimentInterfaces.recordAuthority: evaluator store keyed by runId/sceneId/attemptId; missing ref is EVAL failure, not a hidden global
experimentInterfaces.failure: missing denominator definition or missing declared record/ref is not a result
experimentInterfaces.resourceBasis: report charged cost; do not hide Prep/Recover/retry
